cases.why: the changelog's no-data branch uses the calm 'waiting' kind, so a build that lost its version list looks like a page that simply has nothing yet -- the flattering reading of a broken page.
cases.find: stateHtml('missing', 'No version history in this build'
cases.replace: stateHtml('waiting', 'No version history in this build'

cases.why: the Week Board filter hides every game and the page says so with no way back but finding the filter row again -- a dead end the state exists to prevent.
the missing kind goes back to the dashed border every other state wears, so a broken build and a quiet week are drawn the same.
the SOS note returns to .table-note, a second way of saying 'nothing here' beside the component that replaced it.
the page loads something after it is built, and there is still no loading state -- the premise the Page states comment rests on stops being true.
